content: Always ask for direct confirmation before starting any implementation or writing code. Never begin coding without explicit approval.
Before building or debugging, always check relevant memories first — they may have rules, gotchas, or patterns that prevent mistakes.

htmx has no built-in/extension to "reset a form after successful submit" — it's a known gap (open issue bigskysoftware/htmx#3198). For form-clearing/focus after submit, use hx-on::after-request with the `event.detail.successful` guard (true on 20x), NOT after-settle. after-settle fires from the swap target; if the handler retargets elsewhere (e.g. HX-Retarget: #comment-list on success), after-settle never reaches the form, and on the error path (form self-swaps with preserved Body) it wipes the text the server deliberately preserved.

In templ, `@Component()` calls glued to text on the same line are NOT parsed as calls — templ emits them as literal raw text (build still succeeds, so it's a silent runtime bug). Component calls must be a standalone node on their own line. Text + inline HTML elements or `{ expr }` interpolation DO work inline, but text + `@Component()` does not. Symptom: literal `@Foo(...)` string appearing in the browser.
